smartFlows are 1h per-wallet Smart Inflow card rows from the signed-in GMGN endpoint smartmoney_cards/cards/sol/1h (Monitor > Smart, 1h, https://gmgn.ai/monitor?chain=sol&tab=smartdegen), not the left-rail Smart Degen feed or Smart Net Inflow aggregates. The payload had 100 token cards and included every wallet row on each card, not only the rows visible in the virtualized board. usd is the signed 1h net inflow the API returned (net_inflow); some Sell All/Sell Partial rows are still positive (and a few First Buy/Buy More rows negative) because that column is 1h net, not the last fill. Action labels First Buy / Buy More / Sell All / Sell Partial were taken from the API side + is_open_or_close fields (buy+1, buy+0, sell+1, sell+0). The inflow API used is the page-load payload from the same signed-in session (HAR exported after DevTools was opened with Preserve log and Disable cache, the log was cleared, monitor was reloaded, then trending was opened). 1 wallet rows were skipped for a missing action, address, or net inflow.

walletFull (complete base58) was recorded from the API wallet_address field (the same full addresses GMGN exposes on wallet links). Wallet labels use a GMGN name/twitter/ENS label when the payload had one, otherwise the prefix...suffix abbreviation.
